profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Riot Games
profile.summary:
I've worked across the tech stack, from backend services to client applications but I find game development the most exciting! I enjoy the complex problems that come with building games and the challenge of making gameplay feel intelligent, immersive, and fun. My broad experience has taught me how to tackle challenges from all angles, allowing me to dive into any problem space needed to deliver on our promises to players.

For the past two years, I’ve been focused on AI-driven gameplay, working on bot AI and combat systems for League of Legends. I love tackling complex challenges that make games feel more immersive, intelligent, and exciting for players.

Beyond my work at Riot, I’m passionate about mentorship, education, and building inclusive spaces in tech. I enjoy helping others grow in their careers whether through volunteering, mentoring newcomers, or fostering team environments where collaboration and learning thrive.

I’m also a co-founder of Riot Unidos, an employee resource group dedicated to building and fostering community for Latino/e professionals in gaming at Riot Games. Through Riot Unidos, we’ve created initiatives to celebrate culture, support career development, and increase representation in the industry.

Game development is a team effort, and I find the most fulfillment in working alongside engineers, designers, and creatives to bring ideas to life. I'm always excited to explore new ways AI can enhance game design and push the boundaries of player experiences. Let’s connect :)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Bot AI - LoL PC Bots Team
- Redesigned the bot AI system for League of Legends, improving bot decision-making and team composition.
- Developed and optimized Behavioral Trees for AI bots in League of Legends, enhancing their strategic play.
- Led the initiative to update bot team composition services to support the new bot system, ensuring seamless integration, leading to more robust AI teams.
- Worked cross-functionally across multiple teams to successfully ship the system on time.

Summoner’s Rift & Riot Client Teams
- Contributed to UI development within Riot’s proprietary engine for an unreleased project.
- Implemented localization support for Riot Client’s system tray on Windows.
- Authored and secured approval for a client uninstall proposal, streamlining the removal process.
- Built the Promotional Card feature and led efforts to improve how game modes & events are displayed in the client. 

Leadership & Collaboration
- Mentored junior engineers, fostering a culture of knowledge-sharing and collaboration.
- Championed pair programming, improving team efficiency and engineering best practices.
- Played a key role in process improvements between Engineering, QA, UX, and Product teams.
- Served on emergent rotation, handling triage for incoming bugs and feature requests.

positions.title: Volunteer
positions.description:
- Taught Intro to Computer Science at USC Brio College Prep.
- Designed and delivered lessons on Python and Scratch, helping students develop foundational programming skills.
- Developed lesson plans, graded assignments, and provided mentorship to students.
- Trained the primary teacher in programming fundamentals, ensuring they could independently teach the course in the future.

positions.title: System Administrator
positions.description:
- Deploy, configure, and document complex environments including engineering designs and recommendations, deployment plans, system configurations, assembly guides and operational smart books.
- Install, configure, and maintain server instance and its applicable database server/services.
- Install configure, and maintain all hosts within the environment.
- Create virtual machines in support of system fielding, integration, and/or expansion.
- Create, configure, and maintain resource clusters ensuring an efficient and balanced environment for all tenant systems.
- Manage Virtual Machine snapshots.
- Afaria configuration and administration.

positions.title: Jr. System Administrator
positions.locationName: 100 S. Main St. Los Angeles, CA 90012
positions.description:
• Design and implement project for efficient management of      systems; currently migrating 600+ users to Active Directory from Novell eDirectory as well as creating group policies specific to each division.
• Maintain System Network.
• Provide technical support for 600+ users.
• Deployed Dell KACE Systems Management Solution.

projects.title: Microsoft Active Directory Implementation
projects.description:
• Designed detailed migration plan to Microsoft Active Directory.
• Support Client Configuration and User Acceptance testing.
• Created specific Group Policies for each Bureau division and department.
•	Project involved meeting timelines, milestones, and assigning specific tasks to team members.
